checks: Real install/retained-ISO startup; Windows+A opens a slot-free provider-backed panel, unsupported network retry is disabled, PCM level/mute updates the actual provider, and one visible Start click switches menus
Actual UTC calendar values and bounded month navigation drive an explicit Calendar launch for the selected real date; the panel itself does not create an application window

Devices opens the required real inventory; USB excludes the system SATA disk in no-device state, keyboard focus and Escape work, and completed panel/app journeys retain zero managed pages and halt at idle
Changing PCM level while Save As owns a dirty Editor applies only to the live provider: the exact whole disk and saved level remain unchanged, and Escape preserves the picker and unsaved text

USB tray actions bind to the real storage generation; safe removal completes its provider flush, a held click cannot eject a same-slot replacement, and explicit replacement import matches independent source bytes without changing either USB image

Two ordinary no-ISO startups preserve exact Start preferences and provider volume; both Windows-key+A routes work with USB HID and legacy PS/2, with no flyout retained after closing and no idle polling
